en: Multi‑view color postcard showing Târgu Mureș, Romania: a tall modernist high‑rise labeled Hotel Grand; a modern plaza identified as Theatre Square with low white buildings and flowerbeds; an aerial view of the central area with the clock‑towered Administrative Palace and the Culture Palace near Roses Square; and a broad boulevard with apartment blocks and a statue. The reverse has Romanian stamps and postmarks and handwritten Romanian message dated 1982, addressed to Bucharest.
